subject: us-west-2 redundancy degradation — impact verification and postmortem request
messages:
From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@clearpay.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: ClearPay Ops <payments@clearpay.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 03:07:00 +0000
Subject: High error rate from us-west-2 between 02:45-03:15 UTC — asking for confirmation on redundancy failure

Hi Neha,

We saw a sustained spike in 503/504 errors and elevated tail latency for inference calls hitting us-west-2 between ~02:45 and 03:15 UTC this morning. Our checkout flow experienced a ~12% failure rate for tokenization requests during that 30m window.

Can you confirm whether there was a regional redundancy/replica failure on your side during that timeframe? If so, we need:
- Confirmation of the affected nodes/shards and exact impact window
- Whether this qualifies for an SLA remedy under our contract (BrightCart Enterprise, SLO: 99.95% availability)
- A request for an evidence bundle (raw traces + aggregated traffic snapshot) and an expected timeline for a postmortem

We're fairly sensitive to this window — it coincided with a promo push. Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can evaluate customer impact.

Thanks,
Tom Reeves
Director, Payments Engineering
ClearPay
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@clearpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 03:25:00 +0000
Subject: Re: High error rate from us-west-2 between 02:45-03:15 UTC — asking for confirmation on redundancy failure

Tom — thanks for the flag and the detail. We are investigating now. Quick note on next steps:
- I'll pull the raw trace bundle and a traffic snapshot for the exact window and share within 6 hours.
- Marissa (SRE) will validate whether a regional replica eviction or degraded redundancy path occurred.
- If the event meets our incident criteria for an availability SLO hit, we'll document the impact window and start a postmortem.

Can you confirm the customer-facing errors you saw (examples of request ids or timestamps are helpful)? If you can paste 2–3 failing request IDs, our logs will reconcile faster.

I'll follow up shortly with an initial impact statement.

-neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@clearpay.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 06:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: High error rate from us-west-2 between 02:45-03:15 UTC — asking for confirmation on redundancy failure

On Thu, Apr 12, 2028 at 03:25 Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Tom — thanks for the flag and the detail. We are investigating now.

Tom / Neha — preliminary findings from the serving logs and autoscaler traces:
- At 02:42:17 UTC we observed an orchestrator event that evicted one replica group servicing a subset of customers in us-west-2 due to an NVLink extents error on host gw-usw2-13. The eviction caused ~10s of elevated queueing for some shards while traffic migrated.
- Between 02:45:00–03:12:00 UTC we saw bursty 503s correlated with increased pending request queue lengths on the affected nodes.
- We do not see a full region outage; redundancy rerouted requests but some long-tail requests timed out before KV-cache warmup completed.

Attached: raw trace archive (usw2-raw-traces-20280412.tar.gz) and a per-minute traffic snapshot (usw2-traffic-snapshot-20280412.csv).

Next steps we propose:
1) We'll compile a precise impact window per your account and provide a reconciliation of your failing request ids (please send any you have).
2) Diego will scope whether this meets contractual SLA remedy thresholds and propose a compensation calculation.
3) We'll schedule a postmortem write-up and share a draft within 3 business days.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll keep this thread updated.

-Marissa Cole
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: usw2-raw-traces-20280412.tar.gz (logs), usw2-traffic-snapshot-20280412.csv (csv)
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@clearpay.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 18:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: High error rate from us-west-2 between 02:45-03:15 UTC — asking for confirmation on redundancy failure

Tom — thanks for your patience. I reviewed the telemetry and contract terms. Summary:
- Verified impact window for ClearPay: 2028-04-12T02:45:10Z — 2028-04-12T03:11:48Z (aggregate 26m38s of elevated error rate).
- Root cause: transient NVLink error on gw-usw2-13 that led to a replica eviction and slower KV-cache population for pinned sessions. Redundancy worked as designed but did not prevent tail timeouts for a subset of in-flight requests.

SLA implication and remedy path:
- Based on your BrightCart Enterprise agreement, the availability SLO calculation for this billing period shows an availability delta that crosses the threshold for a pro-rata remedy for the impacted minutes.
- Proposed remedy: pro-rata service credit for the impacted window (calculation attached). We can expedite a one-time account credit if you prefer quick remediation; otherwise we can process it through procurement for your invoicing cycle.

Action items:
- Please confirm whether ClearPay prefers an expedited credit (applied to your next invoice) or a formal procurement adjustment.
- We're preparing a joint postmortem draft; we've attached a postmortem template (postmortem-template.docx). Expect a full narrative, timeline, mitigations planned, and mitigations to reduce warmup tail. Draft due EOD Apr 15 (3 business days).

Tom — if you can share two failing request ids, we will attach the per-request reconciliation in the postmortem.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Support Escalations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-credit-calculation.pdf (pdf)
